Name: Ceremonial Rite
Components: V, S, M (25 gp worth of powdered silver, which the spell consumes)
Description:
You perform a special religious ceremony that is infused with magic. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following rites, the target of which must be within 10 feet of you throughout the casting.

Atonement. You touch one willing creature whose alignment has been changed, and you make a DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check. On a successful check, you restore the target to their original alignment.

Awaken. You touch one creature who is at 0 hit points but stable. They awaken, regaining hit points equal to 2d8 × the level this spell was cast at, and immediately benefit from a Short Rest.

Bless Water. You touch one vial of water and cause it to become holy water.

Coming of Age. You touch one humanoid who is a young adult. For the next 24 hours, whenever the target makes an ability check, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. A creature can benefit from this rite only once.

Dedication. You touch one humanoid who wishes to be dedicated to your god’s service. For the next 24 hours, whenever the target makes a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the save. A creature can benefit from this rite only once.

Funeral Rite. You touch one corpse, and for the next 7 days, the target can’t become undead by any means short of a wish spell.

Sanctify. You spend the spell’s casting time focusing on a cube equal to 10 feet × the level the spell is cast at, centered on you. Once you complete the spell, invisible undead within that cube are plainly seen for 24 hours, and undead in the ethereal plane can be interacted with as if on the Material Plane.

Treatment. You touch one vial of water while within 10 feet of a sickened creature suffering from poison or a disease. The water in the vial becomes a medicinal drink, and once consumed a creature has advantage on saving throws made against poison or disease for 7 days.

Wedding. You touch adult humanoids willing to be bonded together in a marriage. For the next 7 days, each target gains a +2 AC bonus while they are within 30 feet of each other. A creature can benefit from this rite again only if widowed, and for the purposes of this spell those individuals are considered married.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
